load_contract.failure_behavior: native error path invoked for open failure or short read

normalization.attribute_mapping: each attribute byte is passed through native mapper at 0x0040E9B5

character_rule.condition: attribute bit 0x08 is clear and character is 0xDC or 0xDF

normalization.default_buffer_writeback: normalized attribute and applicable character are written to internal 4000-byte screen buffer

distribution_scope: WCC utility path; shared WCC/WBB BIN assets were previously proven byte-identical
limits: The internal attribute mapper implementation is not renamed as a Worldgroup palette algorithm without additional proof.
Final physical console-write ordering remains outside this closure.
